title: Unit laws of canonical unbounded derived direct image comparisons
statement: Fix unbounded derived categories of module sheaves on every scheme [def-pc-derived-category] and derived direct images [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Suppose c(f,g): Rg_* composed with Rf_* is isomorphic to R(gf)_* for all scheme morphisms and its inverse satisfies the pasted right-derived unit equation. There exist identity comparisons i(X): R(id_X)_* is isomorphic to the identity, such that c(id_X,f) equals Rf_* applied to i(X) and c(f,id_Y) equals i(Y) applied after Rf_*, with the canonical identifications induced by id_comp and comp_id. These are natural-transformation equalities, stated componentwise on every derived object.

source.place: Tag 0D5T (Lemma 20.28.2), coherence expanded using the universal property of the construction in Tag 079V

proof.text: Identify the underived pushforward along the identity with the identity functor (definitionally in the sectionwise construction). Exhibit the identity functor on the derived category as right derived using the invertible identity localization unit, and apply rightDerivedUnique. Apply rightDerivedFunctorNatIso to the underived identification and compose with this canonical identity comparison. These are actual constructions; the private identity comparison is irreducible and is used through its proved identity factorization law.

For an additive functor F and U equal to the identity, consider a: RU composed with RF is isomorphic to RF satisfying the pasted unit equation. After substituting U = Id, compose a.inv with RF of the canonical identity comparison. Precomposition with the unit of RF gives its own unit, by functoriality and the identity factorization equation. Mathlib rightDerived_ext gives a.inv followed by the proposed unitor equal to the identity. Cancel a.inv using its inverse to identify a.hom with the proposed left unitor.

For the right unit use a: RF composed with RU is isomorphic to RF. After U = Id, compose a.inv with the identity comparison evaluated after RF. Naturality of the identity comparison moves it past RId applied to the unit of F; the identity factorization cancels the remaining identity-derived unit. Apply rightDerived_ext to obtain a.inv followed by the proposed unitor equal to the identity, and cancel a.inv.

Transport each of the two abstract component equations along the equality of the composite morphism with f, using substitution of an abstract morphism parameter. Specialize the resulting lemmas to module direct image, the identity pushforward, c(id_X,f), c(f,id_Y), and hc. The equality transports are exactly the displayed eqToHom terms for id_comp and comp_id. Use the constructed identity comparisons for the existential witness.

proof_origin.note: Complete Lean proof by the right-derived universal property; two proved private abstract unit-law lemmas and equality transport. The identity comparison is constructed through rightDerivedFunctorNatIso and rightDerivedUnique, avoiding reduction of a transport of a whole derived functor.

lean.statement:
theorem derivedDirectImageComposition_unit_laws
    [d : ∀ X : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (c : ∀ {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z),
      schemeDerivedDirectImage f ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage g ≅
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (f ≫ g))
    (hc : ∀ {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
        (K : HomotopyCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)),
      (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (f ≫ g).toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app K ≫
          (c f g).inv.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj K) =
        (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage g.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app
            (((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).mapHomotopyCategory
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K) ≫
          (schemeDerivedDirectImage g).map
            ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app K)) :
    ∃ i : ∀ X : Scheme.{u}, schemeDerivedDirectImage (𝟙 X) ≅ 𝟭 (schemeDerivedCategory X),
      (∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (E : schemeDerivedCategory X),
        (c (𝟙 X) f).hom.app E ≫
            eqToHom (congrArg (fun k : X ⟶ Y => (schemeDerivedDirectImage k).obj E)
              (Category.id_comp f)) =
          (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).map ((i X).hom.app E)) ∧
      (∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (E : schemeDerivedCategory X),
        (c f (𝟙 Y)).hom.app E ≫
            eqToHom (congrArg (fun k : X ⟶ Y => (schemeDerivedDirectImage k).obj E)
              (Category.comp_id f)) =
          (i Y).hom.app ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E))
